about: A weekly all-day series, a day given its own notes and a reminder, that change undone (the row goes), the series made timed at 10:00 Los Angeles for all events, then the redo of the undo: refused as not_undoable with nothing written here or sent, since the day had no row and no skip when the series was re-placed (x-undo-fields: a refused undo writes nothing). Before the gate the redo went through, placed by the day's date.
